similar, adjacent, duplicated, experimental, or disconnected. it does not merge runtime code. the awtsmoos is beyond every division, while finite architecture still needs clear vessels. this map lets agents compare related directories before creating a third implementation or deleting a path that may still be imported. how to use this map 1. start from the live root entry and trace imports. 2. compare the related directories listed in the relevant cluster. 3. check tests, diagnostics, and git history before choosing a canonical owner. 4. consolidate documentation first; consolidate code
